subject: Action required: confirm POC playbook, owners & exec readout slot
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Sophia Martinez <sophia@novamed.com>, Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposal: POC playbook & next steps

Hi Sophia / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we draft the formal POC plan:

Summary of needs (from our conversation)
- Use case: ingest clinical notes and accelerate physician summarization + QA checks for coding.
- Primary success metric: 95% reduction in average physician summary time for high-priority workflows (baseline: ~45s -> target <10s for priority docs).
- Quality gate: automated summaries must hit >= 90% match vs. human QA on 200 sampled notes across specialties.
- Data scope: de-identified sample of 5K notes, plus live endpoint for 2-week shadow traffic during sprint 3.

Proposed POC structure (high level)
1) Week 0: Kickoff + test data ingestion; security onboarding (VPN + KMS config).
2) Week 1–2: Model tuning & sample evaluation (offline runs against 200-note eval set).
3) Week 3: Integration test with clinician UI (shadow mode).
4) Week 4: Final readout + exec decision window.

Owners we discussed
- Redwood AE / engagement: Jonas Weber (me) — program owner, exec readout coordination.
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole — success metric monitoring and runbooks.
- Redwood SE: Rishi Malhotra — ingestion + infra validation.
- Novamed: Sophia Martinez — clinical sponsor; Daniel Lee — platform/IT owner.

Attachments: I attached a short POC_Playbook_Template.xlsx and a one-pager for success criteria (Novamed_SuccessCriteria.docx). Please review and suggest edits.

Ask: Can you confirm the success metrics above and whether the proposed 4-week cadence fits your timeline? If that works, we’ll lock in dates and I’ll request an exec readout slot with our leadership for the week of Jul 26.

Thanks — looking forward.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sophia Martinez <sophia@novamed.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@novamed.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal: POC playbook & next steps

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Baseline: the 45s average you used is correct for the specialty set we discussed (ED + Cardio). We can supply the labeled eval set of ~220 notes by Friday.
2) Quality gate: the 90% match metric — can you confirm whether that’s exact-string overlap or semantic alignment? Our compliance team will want documentation on evaluation methodology.
3) Timeline: 4 weeks is aggressive but feasible if we can parallelize the offline eval and the clinician UI shadow.

We do need an explicit SLA for data handling during the shadow period (audit logs + immediate purge after 30 days). Can Marissa confirm Redwood’s standard logging/retention for Private deployment customers?

If you send an updated playbook with the clarifications, I’ll route to our legal and clinical teams.

— Sophia
Director of Clinical Informatics, Novamed Health

On Mon, Jul 12, 2027 at 08:08 AM jonas.weber@redwood.com wrote:
> (original message above)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Sophia Martinez <sophia@novamed.com>, Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal: POC playbook & next steps

Sophia — great questions. See answers below and I’ve updated the playbook accordingly (attached).

1) Quality metric definition: we’ll use a semantic F1-style scoring with human adjudication. Short summary: we compute token-level overlap + a reviewer adjudication for borderline cases; final pass reports both exact overlap and semantic-F1. I included a short eval_methods appendix in Novamed_SuccessCriteria.docx describing the process.
2) Data SLA / retention: for the shadow period we will enable audit logs, KMS-backed keys, and a 30-day retention with immediate purge option. Marissa — can you confirm the purge process and provide the standard retention/security bullet list we can share with Novamed legal?
3) Timeline / parallelization: we’ll run the offline tuning (Week 1–2) while Rishi and your team run the UI shadow integration in Week 3; that should keep us on the 4-week cadence with one week buffer.

Next concrete asks:
- Sophia: confirm you can deliver the 220-note eval set by Friday (Jul 16).
- Marissa: please paste the standard security/retention bullets into a quick note we can share externally.
- Rishi: confirm resource availability for Week 3 for the shadow integration test.

I attached an updated POC_Playbook_Template.xlsx (v2) with explicit owners/timeline.

Thanks —
Jonas

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Requesting exec readout slot for Novamed POC (week of Jul 26)

Sean —

Quick internal ask: Novamed looks ready to run the 4-week POC that ends in the week of Jul 26. Outcome is go/no-go for small contract (12-mo, usage-based) and ask for exec readout with a VP present for decision.

Why exec involvement matters: clinical sponsor (Sophia) will present outcomes and asks for pilot commitment; we need a clear decision path to sign a convertible order form and commit a Dedicated capacity trial. Without an exec readout we risk friction in pricing and SLA exceptions.

Proposed slots (please pick one if available):
- Tue, Jul 27, 10:00–10:30 PT (preferred — fits Novamed stakeholders)
- Wed, Jul 28, 14:00–14:30 PT

Decision criteria I’ll present:
- Met success metric: >=90% semantic-F1 on eval set + >60% reduction in clinician mean time-to-summary for priority docs.
- Security checklist signed off (KMS/audit logs/data purge).
- LOI / purchase intent from Novamed legal with standard terms (no net-90 exceptions).

Attachments: I included the updated playbook and the success criteria doc for your review.

If you can confirm one of those slots and whether you want Product or Legal there, I’ll lock the invite and prep the one-page readout deck.

— Jonas

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Requesting exec readout slot for Novamed POC (week of Jul 26)

Thanks — Jonas. Slot confirmed: Tue, Jul 27, 10:00–10:30 PT. I’ll join as the decision owner. Please include Legal for the contract ask; loop in Tessa from Legal (tessa.morgan@redwood.com) and Julian from Product if you need technical context.

A couple of notes:
- If the evaluation misses the 90% semantic-F1 but shows strong time savings (>70% reduction), be prepared to propose a conditional pilot with tighter QA gates rather than outright no-go.
- For pricing negotiation: don’t commit to Dedicated capacity without expressing an expected utilization profile — we need to hold the pricing conversation until after readout.

Jonas — once you confirm the eval delivery (Sophia) and Marissa posts the security lane, I’ll accept the invite and ask Legal to prep a short LOI template.

— Sean
Senior Director, Sales Operations
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
